changelog:
Initial release of the ztm-tunnel skill.

- Create and manage secure TCP/UDP tunnels between ZTM network endpoints.
- Provides commands for creating, listing, describing, and deleting tunnels.
- Supports inbound (listen locally) and outbound (forward to remote target) tunnel setups.
- Includes troubleshooting steps and example use cases for port forwarding services.
- Outlines required configuration, installation steps, and available API endpoints.
summary: Create and manage TCP/UDP tunnels between ZTM network endpoints. Use this to establish secure P2P port forwarding through the ZTM mesh network.
